summary: Improve discoverability through useful content and technically sound websites.
intents: why is our site not ranking on Google
audit this page for SEO issues
improve title tags and meta descriptions
find broken links on our website
not_for: simple definitions of search keywords without a website discovery task
standalone brand tagline writing without organic search or website optimization
prerequisites: website or representative pages and the intended audience
access to crawl/indexing information or analytics where available
current search-engine documentation for changing technical requirements

verify.description: On-page SEO audit scores at least 80

verify: Recommendations favour useful content over keyword stuffing
Changes are measured against a baseline from search console data
